rationale.conceptual: The method, though established (critical-state plasticity framework, MD with modified BKS potential), requires non-trivial setup: correct potential parameterization, melt-quench protocol, identification of densification and critical-state plateaus. Dependency exists, and the long simulations (~40h total) demand careful resource management. Environment setup (LAMMPS) is straightforward, and I/O is simple CSV.
